description.zh: 要接收消息的设备名称。
description.en: The device name of the target device.

description.zh:
发送消息给云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备时，需要传入此参数，标识消息的命令类型，可取值：

- **128**：查询命令（0x80）。
- **129**：设置命令（0x81）。
- **130**：车载终端控制命令（0x82）。


云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备接入详情，请参见[云网关GB/T 32960协议概述](~~2248990~~)。
description.en:
This parameter is required when sending a message to a device that uses the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol. It specifies the command type of the message. Valid values:
- **128**: Query command (0x80).
- **129**: Set command (0x81).
- **130**: In-vehicle terminal control command (0x82).

For more information about connecting devices that use the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol, see [Overview of the Cloud Gateway GB/T 32960 Protocol](~~2248990~~).

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** does not exist, this parameter is not required.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
要发送的消息主体。

您需要将消息原文转换成二进制数据，并进行Base64编码，从而生成消息主体。
description.en:
The body of the message to be sent.

You must convert the original message into binary data and then encode it in Base64 to generate the message body.

description.zh: 要接收消息的设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。
description.en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the target device belongs.

description.zh:
发送消息给MQTT协议设备时，需要传入对应设备的自定义Topic。Topic的操作权限必须为**订阅**或**发布和订阅**。

发送消息给云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备时，无需传入此参数。
description.en:
When sending a message to a device that uses the MQTT protocol, you must specify the custom topic of the corresponding device. The operation permission of the topic must be **subscribe** or **publish and subscribe**.

When sending a message to a device that uses the GB/T 32960 protocol via a cloud gateway, you do not need to specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
对于MQTT协议（包括云网关和非云网关）和云网关GB/T 32960协议的设备，可调用本接口从服务端下发消息给对应设备。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为1,000。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You can call this API to send messages from the server to devices that use the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol (including cloud gateway and non-cloud gateway devices) or the cloud gateway GB/T 32960 protocol.

## QPS Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API is 1,000 per Alibaba Cloud account.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot async-rrpc --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --product-key aldfeSe0000 --device-name device1 --ext-info commandType_:_128 --message-content eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBwdWIgYnJvYWRjYXN0In0= --topic-full-name /a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot AsyncRRpc --region cn-hangzhou --MessageContent 'eyJ0ZXN0IjoidGFzayBwdWIgYnJvYWRjYXN0In0=' --IotInstanceId 'iot-v6400000000' --ExtInfo 'commandType_:_128' --ProductKey aldfeSe0000 --DeviceName device1 --TopicFullName '/a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update'
